centered_endpoint_formula.alias_coherence: |Omega/L-m|<=1/M; m=0,±1,±2 are distinct classes, with exact Omega=0 already discharged only by Decision I.
centered_endpoint_formula.kernel: K_center(E,ell,Omega)=sum_(k in E intersect K_ell) exp(2*pi*i*k*Omega/L) - (|E|/d)*sum_(k in K_ell) exp(2*pi*i*k*Omega/L)
centered_endpoint_formula.normalization: The global centering is u/d (or v/d) times the full K_ell sum; it is retained and is not replaced by a signed mean estimate.

classification: J2 — exact finite-section full-frequency path representation established and the fixed-gap far-alias sector has a stronger source-valid absolute bound; near aliases and full transfer remain open

comparison.decision_g_h: Prior diagonal-score and one-sided endpoint expansions retain root/finite-path dependence but did not expose one common endpoint phase in every cubic path summand.
comparison.decision_i: Exact zero-carrier UFD sector bound O(L^-3) remains valid and separate.
comparison.infinite_no_wrap: The older infinite partial-translation formula already has a full displacement frequency with continuum overlap weight; the present formula adds the exact finite-J discrete root set and exact endpoint centering. It is an exact organization, not a new asymptotic saving.

entry_formula.adjoint: U_(n,sigma)^*=U_(n,-sigma); J_ij=1/(pi*(j-i)) is used with the stated (j-i) orientation
entry_formula.finite_lag_scope: No R=6000 truncation; all integer lags are retained, with root set empty outside the actual finite section.

finite_regression.s0: omitted; this tests V^3 only, as required for R_nonzero

lag_summability.centered_kernel_bound: |K_center|<=2*|E|<=2*M; both endpoint sides together therefore have absolute lag-tail bound <=32*M*S(T)^3*tail(R)
lag_summability.normalized_natural_scale: O((M/d)*N^(3/2)/L^3*R^(-1/3))=O(exp(3L/2-2*sqrt(L))*R^(-1/3)/L^3); this does not tend to zero for fixed R and does not justify deleting long lags
lag_summability.prime_mass: S(T)=sum_(n in P(N))|c_n|=O(sqrt(N)/L); summing the triple coefficient mass contributes S(T)^3 and all eight sign vectors
lag_summability.scope: The lag-only summability is valid, but after coefficient and endpoint weights it is not a negligible tail estimate. All lags remain in the exact formula.

quantitative_gate.alias_neighborhoods: The complementary fixed neighborhoods of m=0,+-1,+-2 retain the O(M) coherent endpoint kernel; the exact zero-carrier part alone is controlled by Decision I. No bound closes the remaining nonzero near aliases.
quantitative_gate.decisive_obstruction: The exact phase reunification does not bound the signed weighted sum over source triples near Omega/L=m; coefficient L1 mass times the full lag norm gives a growing natural-cutoff upper envelope.
quantitative_gate.far_sector: For fixed delta in (0,1/2), dist(Omega/L,Z)>=delta implies |K_center|<=2/sin(pi*delta). Summing all lags and the full prime-power coefficient mass gives E_u|Y_far,L|+E_v|Y_far,R|<=32*||w||_(3/2)^3*S(T)^3/sin(pi*delta). After division by d this is O_delta(N^(3/2)/(T*L^4))=O_delta(exp(L/2-3*sqrt(L)/2)/L^4), a genuine improvement over the inherited O(K_T*M/d)=O(exp(L/2-sqrt(L))/L) envelope by factor O_delta(exp(-sqrt(L)/2)/L^3), but it still diverges.
quantitative_gate.first_missing_estimate: A uniform source-weighted centered endpoint estimate for the exact K_center sum above, retaining m=0 nonzero near aliases and m=±1,±2 aliases, full P(N), and all finite-section paths, with total o(d).
quantitative_gate.new_saving: No signed or positive constant saving is certified; the far-sector upper bound is absolute, source-valid, stronger than the inherited global envelope, and insufficient because it grows.

relative_lag_identity.carrier: product_j c_(n_j)*exp(i*T*Omega); all prime powers n_j=p^v<=N retained
relative_lag_identity.endpoint_intersection: For either contiguous endpoint interval E_u or E_v, E intersect K_ell is contiguous or empty
relative_lag_identity.root_set: K_ell={k in I0:k+q0,k+q1,k+q2 all in I0}; for I0=[b,b+d-1], this is [b-min(q), b+d-1-max(q)] intersected with integers, empty if max(q)-min(q)>d-1

theorem_boundary: m3=2, conditioned Cayley energy<0.105, signed fifth/sixth gate, prime-to-Weil identification, zero-side transfer, determinant compatibility, and strict >79% remain OPEN.
